Nice to meet you.
I would like to ask if you could draw the character in the URL.
The illustration was drawn by Kanju (@poyo029), and I have permission to use it as a reference material.

The character is cheerful and cheerful personality.
She has a cheerful personality.
She is about 160cm tall.
She is skilled with a sword and a bow.

Purpose of use
Please note that the illustration may be used for the following purposes.
Wallpaper for PCs and smartphones (the size is up to you).
Headers and icons for SNS such as Note and X (Twitter).
Reference material for future requests for illustrations, novels, cartoons, and music.
Illustrations will be posted on SNS such as "note" and "X (Twitter)".

Other

Nice to meet you!
I would like to make a request for your illustration, which is very cute and nice.
I would like you to draw a character of myself (a character based on a black swallowtail butterfly called Kurochoba Kuroro).
I will share my Google Drive for the visual.
I would like to ask you to draw a music video illustration to be used in a song I sang called "Kakashika".
We may use them for videos and their thumbnails, thumbnails for distribution and delivery, return gifts, and goods.
We would also like to have a variety of facial expressions and backgrounds to the extent possible, which would look great in a music video.
We would appreciate it if you could do so.

Dear mink
I am sorry for the sketch request.
I saw your illustration on Twitter and thought it was very nice.

 Character
Please refer to my Twitter URL for the standing picture.

Hair style, clothes, and other things (please leave the horns, wings, and tail as they are!) The composition of the picture is entirely up to mink.
We would be very happy if you could draw a picture filled with your favorite things.

 We would like to use the illustration as a thumbnail for distribution, as a return gift, on Twitter, etc. If you have a background for the illustration, we would like to have a separate transparency for the person only.

Thank you very much!

はじめまして、スケブでお見かけした女の子がとても可愛らしくて惹かれました。
Twitterに投稿しているスケッチも素晴らしいですね！
素朴なタッチの中に生き生きした表情が活写され、センスのよさと才能を感じます。

よろしければ小説家になろうやエブリスタに掲載している自作ホラー小説、「サムワンサム」の表紙（イメージイラスト）を描いてください。

■あらすじ
父が営むトウモロコシ畑を今日も今日とて駆け回るおてんばサム。
収穫期に訪れる出稼ぎ労働者たちとも仲良しだ。

ある日サムが案山子の根元に埋めた宝箱を掘り返していると、口がきけない大男が現れた。
過去の惨劇のショックで言葉を忘れた彼は、仲間内でサイレンス・ジョニー……だんまりジョニーと呼ばれている。
サムはジョニーと大親友になるのだが……。
（ホラー/ミステリー/短編）

■描いてほしい人物
サム（7）
赤毛癖っ毛ショートヘア　鼻梁にそばかす　濃紺のオーバーオール
見た目はやんちゃそうな可愛い男の子だが実はボーイッシュな女児
事情があって男の子の格好をさせられている
上記の特徴を踏まえていればキャラデザ詳細はおまかせ
自由に楽しく描いてください

■雰囲気
ノスタルジック　オールドアメリカ　ジュブナイルホラー　牧歌的だがほんのり不吉で不気味　トウモロコシ畑に潜む狂気

■シチュ
真夏のトウモロコシ畑（背景が難しそうなら簡略化ＯＫ）
時間帯は朝～夜の間でおまかせ

■その他モチーフ
ブギーマン　案山子　麦わら帽子　農具（使えそうなのがあれば使ってください）

アレンジ歓迎
不明点や詳細おまかせ

完成品はネット小説の表紙や宣伝他、kindleで販売する電子書籍に使わせてください
